layers.authority: Administración del Parque Provincial Ischigualasto (San Juan)
layers.process: Ischigualasto Provincial Park: the daytime traditional circuit (40 km, five stops, about 3 hours, done in vehicles) runs on arrival with no booking, with departures about every hour from 8:00 to 17:00. In hot months entries stop at 11:00 and resume at 16:00. Entry fees are not published on the park's own site, so none are recorded here.

layers.authority: Administración del Parque Provincial Ischigualasto (San Juan)
layers.process: Ischigualasto Provincial Park: the full-moon circuit (about 2.5 hours, ages 10 and over), the Cerro Morado walk (5.73 km, high difficulty), the Río Salado walk (ages 10 and over) and the mountain-bike circuit run by booking through the park's phone, WhatsApp or email contacts on its site, and depend on weather at the start. The full-moon circuit runs only four nights a month, around the lunar phase change.
